sportsPage.heading: Sports sections
sportsPage.subtitle: Manage the ordered list of Sports page sections (hero, Top Stories, Live, World, and sport rows) for each scope. US uses one list per state and Florida county; PR uses one list for the market and each town; other countries use one list for the market. Saving creates categories and layout slots. Place stories under Placement → Page → sports.
sportsPage.listHint: Add, remove, rename, or reorder any section—including Ribbon Advertisement rows between sports. Saving updates Placement → sports for the same market, state, county, or town. Compact sport rows also keep an ad ribbon every two rows.
sportsPage.saveSuccess: Sports list saved. Use Placement → sports to pin stories, or tag articles with the new sport category.

governmentPage.subtitle: Manage the ordered list of Government page sections (hero, Top Stories, Live, World, and topic rows) for each scope. governmentPage.saveSuccess: Government list saved. Use Placement → government to pin stories, or tag articles with the new topic category.

Place stories under Placement → Page → homepage.

mainPage.saveFailed: Failed to save Main Page list.
